# git-github-mcp
> FastMCP 3.1.1+ hardened substrate for Git and GitHub operations. Uses `gh` CLI for GitHub; v1.20 non-interactive safety enforced. - **git_ops**: clone, status (high-fidelity), add, commit, push, pull, branch, tag, stash - **github_ops**: repo_list, repo_create, pr_list, issue_list.

This project includes automated llms.txt generation for AI accessibility.

## Docs
